text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Fest is here, and ardent
fans from
far and wide have flocked to
Tracen Academy to
glimpse this year's
active Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
The final round of the 34th annual
speed-eating
grand prix is underway!
Our last food for the
contest is taiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Oguri Cap! Her presence is as

overwhelming as ever—could she be
signaling
she's finished her portion
already?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've run out of tea. Do you know where I
might be
able to get some more?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This dessert is delicious, so it would be a
shame
not to enjoy it with some warm
tea...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
And Oguri Cap has walked off! Does she
not
understand what the goal of the
contest is?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
First place is in sight for Super Creek!
...But wait!
Another Umamusume is
surging forward toward
the top spot!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Come on, this is no time to be givin' up!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
And the win goes to Inari One! Oguri's
iron
stomach has finally met its match!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Heh... Witness the power... of
Edo...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Inari, stay with us! It's Mommy. Can you
hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...No. You're not my mommy...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That was a good contest! I never thought
Oguri
Cap would lose!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Yeah! That Inari is pretty strong—I
heard
she's gonna run in the Takarazuka
Kinen too!
...Ouch! Hey, you're stepping
on my foot!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ack! I'm sorry! Did I hurt you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-this place is packed! I can't believe
how
popular the Top Three are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The Top Three"—Oguri Cap, Inari One,
and
Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Skilled and powerful, it's no wonder
they're
popular, both here at the Fan
Fest and in general.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps gluttony is the secret to their
strength...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know what they say! Hunger
rests for no
one! Maybe there's another
contest that's still
looking for
participants!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Register here for the Trainer and Me
Eating
Contest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow... I see... This sure is a lot...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the table in front of us is a mountain
of hot
dogs.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The current record is fifteen! And we're
offering a
special edition Tracen
Academy miniature car to
anyone who
can break it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ooh... That's a nice prize...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surprised by Sakura Chiyono O's unusual
interest,
I prepare to start eating hot
dogs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a plan! Let's aim for sixteen
plates of
hot dogs then!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They count the number of plates
after you
finish, and each plate has ten
hot dogs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If we want to break the record, we'll
need to eat
more than fifteen plates...
So we've gotta aim for
160 hot dogs!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can probably eat about 150 hot dogs
of this
size, so you just need to eat ten,
please and
thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The gong to start rings...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Chomp! Munch!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Hm?! Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look to my side to see that Sakura
Chiyono O
has ground to a halt. She's
staring intently at the
plates with a
strained expression.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Haha... I'm fine... Just... forty hot
dogs... to
go...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I can do it... After all... I usually eat...
way more
than this...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hurgh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Whew. See? I'm perfectly... fine...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Heh. Hehe... Urk...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't see any option but to quit. I stop
Sakura
Chiyono O from eating any more
and rush her to
the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The gong to start rings...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Chomp! Munch!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whew! I'll leave the rest to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a satisfied look on her face, Sakura
Chiyono
O gives the remaining hot dogs
to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've managed to eat eight hot dogs
myself so far,
which means there are
only...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry! I'm just so full... I can usually eat
so much
more than this...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the look on Sakura Chiyono
O's face,
she's already gone past her
limit. And if that's the
case, there's only
one thing I can do...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by Sakura Chiyono O's
enthusiastic
cheering, I somehow
manage to keep shoveling
hot dogs into
my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And finally...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
There you have it, folks! Sakura Chiyono
O and
her trainer have broken the
record! Here's your
prize!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Thank you so much! Aw, it's a
little sedan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After seeing the smile on Sakura
Chiyono O's
face, I promptly pass out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Omigosh! Trainer?! Traineeer!
